items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: So me Wilford, George James, three of us played in the room.

ctx.x: Sure. And did you know that tune, Confessing, from the Lister record? What? Confessing, did you know that from Lister's record?

I don't believe, no. No, I confess, no. I learned from somebody. I mean Walsh, Edmund Walsh, and start playing that. Oh, yeah. Yeah, Edmund Walsh, yeah. He started playing it. Yeah, yeah. He started playing it. Yeah, Walsh. He used to sing it, you know. Yeah, you learned it from him. But I'll tell you what, after we had the band up and everything, and I played at the Monroe Rouge, you see what? We was playing, Larkport, racing, Larkport, Gold Medal, all the way down to Grand Island, Tibido, Bomo, Baton Rouge, all…
Who did you have in the band?
